claim: Major aging and cancer mechanisms become understood
originalWording: Major aging and cancer mechanisms become understood

sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil
sources.locator: P02 Health care in 2019, first clause; lifespan clause separately K027

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Scientists understand many important genetic/cellular processes of aging and cancer; a complete causal model or cure is not required.
reference.rationale: The 2013 hallmarks framework and 2018 Pan-Cancer Atlas demonstrate substantial mechanistic and molecular understanding before 2019. Continued refinement, including 12 aging hallmarks in 2023, does not erase those real insights. The source says many processes, not all biology solved.

evidence.title: López-Otín et al.: The Hallmarks of Aging
evidence.note: Nine tentative mechanistic hallmarks; progress and unresolved interactions both explicit. Mechanistic insight does not establish a cure for aging..
